purpose: Coordinate-frame overlays on faded photographs and plain diagram panels for the frame_figure slot (round 8, M2a; plain panels and the page-7 static markers round 10, M2a).

label_size.rule: effective pt = em_px / (source px per placed inch) * 72 (knowledge/deck_fonts.md)

overlay_modes.projected: axes pushed through the panel camera model from a pinned calibrated pose
overlay_modes.illustrative: anchor and axis directions declared in the spec (anchors may be measured)

reprojection_checks.detector: cv2.aruco.ArucoDetector DICT_5X5_50, CORNER_REFINE_APRILTAG (pinned settings, knowledge/marker_facts.md), corner mean

residual_bound_px.rule: the generator raises when a bounded residual exceeds bound_px (D-303); the unity_* checks are recorded without a bound

reprojection_checks.unity_reference: page-24 measured anchors in r6b_unity_f00505.png (anchored_photos.json anchor_measurement): desk marker corner mean (345.5, 443.0), red pelvis sphere centroid (340.0, 347.7)

unity_anchor_text.Scene: Desk marker (ArUco id 2, same detector) corner mean (345.5, 443.0) px in r6b_unity_f00505.png -> anchor_px [346, 443]; the Scene origin itself lies on the floor below the desk, outside the rendered view
unity_anchor_text.Rig anchor: Centroid of the red joint sphere at the pelvis (R>150, G<60, B<60; 277 px) (340.0, 347.7) px in r6b_unity_f00505.png -> anchor_px [340, 348]
unity_anchor_text.Camera: Placed at the upper-left image corner [34, 72] px; the camera frame has no visible point in the image

unity_pelvis_vs_red_sphere.note: the held sphere sits slightly in front of the bone along the line of sight (thesis Section 6.3), so its centre projects near the bone origin
